# 1.2.119 - the owner's fixes before session 0: the trial's clocks, the planner's look and its Move, the sheet's effects and dice, any item thrown away, the fog's Hide all, the masked and veiled killer kept off boards, Calls and pickers, the Facilities rows, and the Sound tab's files one by one

One stage ships: E119 (tools/stages.json), the owner's table reports and asks of 19-21.11.2026, built by nine lines and
merged into one assembly: shim-118 (the put-back), trial, planner look, sheet, fog, mask and veil, Facilities, sound,
and planner with Season setup. The audit of 1.2.118 routed its findings in those files to the same lines. **E39, E40,
E43, E53, E58 and E83 are not shipped** and move to 1.2.120 (tools/stages.json, 8c3a146e). E26 stays 1.3.0. From
b5a29e73 (main at 1.2.118, tag v1.2.118) to 8c3a146e: 69 commits, 13 of them merges of the lines into the assembly
(`git rev-list --count` and `--merges --count` over b5a29e73..8c3a146e); this release commit comes on top.

In plain words. Everything below is read off the code and the headless harness; none of it has run on a real Foundry or
at a table (## Checked).

**Class Trial** (line T; the owner, 19-20.11.2026).
- A Logic Dive question always runs its full clock; moving the tokens no longer closes it early (R7840). A Scrum Debate
  works the same way and never closes early (R7841).
- A Scrum turn whose camp has nobody to speak runs its clock with no speaker instead of being skipped at once.
- The Closing Argument's music starts only once its speaker is confirmed (music-states.mjs; R7842).

**The planner's look** (line P, four rounds of shots with the owner, 19-20.11.2026).
- Each Remnant type has its own colour, named in a legend under the Map ("Colors on the Map"); deductions, counters and
  the solution read like the Remnants (R7820, R7821, R7827).
- Arrows are square, grouped by their source, leave from their own ports, take the source's colour and end at their
  target's edge; no two arrows of different sources share a stretch (R7822, R7825, R7826, R7829, R7830). A hovered or
  focused node lights its arrows and dims the rest (R7823).
- A deduction and its lines take the colour of its Class Trial mode; each mode's colour stands apart from the others and
  from every type colour (R7831, R7832). Every colour carries its ink at WCAG AA in both themes (tools/contrast-pairs.json;
  R7824, R7828).

**The planner's Move, removals and live redraw** (line C1; the owner, 19-20.11.2026, and the audit of 1.2.118).
- Move up and Move down work on every node again, Key Remnant slots and planned Autopsies included, and say when a node
  cannot go further (investigation.mjs `moveCaseNode`; DRPG.CaseMap.moveEnd.*).
- Removing a node also removes its links (the owner: "Przyjmujemy ze usuniecie bulleta usuwa tez jego polaczenia";
  case-schema.mjs `refsCut`, R7800). Links an older removal left are cut when a GM opens the investigation dashboard
  (`pruneDroppedRefs`, R7801), and a link to something gone that no removal cut is drawn ticked in the node's list, so it
  can be unticked. A Remnant deleted from the dashboard takes the planner's links to it.
- An open planner shows changes at once - made by another GM, another window or on the map - also while a GM types in
  it (the owner's rule: windows refresh at once on a change).
- A case where two counters refute each other, or a counter refutes the deduction resting on it, no longer stops the
  Map from opening (R7802).

**Season setup** (line C1; the audit of 1.2.118, controls-10-setup-config).
- Reset the season opens the reset's own window again.
- Save, and Edit campaign's Apply, write only what the GM changed, so a time step, a trial started or another GM's
  safeword set while the window stood open is not undone (gm-campaign.mjs `untouchedKept`, `changedField`; R7803).
- Season setup's fields and the Season checklist's rows follow changes made elsewhere while they are open; a field the
  GM typed in keeps the text (season-setup.mjs `followWorld`).

**The sheet** (line S; the owner, 20.11.2026).
- The effect badges pile on one another instead of stretching the sheet's header (R7900).
- A roll's Hope and Despair are shown when this browser's dice of that roll have landed (Dice So Nice), on the sheet,
  the Despair track, the Party sheet, the token HUD and, on the GM that writes it, the Overflow; a Reroll waits for its
  own dice. The stored values are written as before; only what each browser draws waits (dice-hold.mjs, settings.mjs
  `onDespairPoolsChange`; R7901-R7905, tier 2 S119-T1 to -T6).
- **Any item can now be thrown away, broken or not** - at the same price: a Shadow roll and a Remnant left in the room.
  Truth Bullets and bedroom keys cannot (inventory.mjs, use-items.mjs `discardBroken`; R7906, S119-T7).

**The fog** (line F; the owner's reading at the table, 20.11.2026).
- **Hide all** in the Fog tab now clears the GM's map: the GM's fog counted every character's ledger row (a Monokuma, a
  character not in the class), so a room stayed lit; it counts the students the Fog tab offers (R7862).
- A write made after a reset whose cut runs ahead of a browser's clock is kept, and the GM is told (gm-store.mjs;
  DRPG.GmStore.cutAhead; R7860, R7861).
- A Spectator's walk is no crossing: no Eclipse count, no record, no Keep Watch (R7863).
- While a direct murder's opening roll waits, the victim's and the bystanders' voice tiles no longer count the hidden
  killer or name them in Who you hear. The killer still hears the room, with their microphone held (voice-tile.mjs,
  visibility.mjs `voiceVeiledHere`; R7864). What avclient-livekit's own window shows is not read (LIVE-F119-03).

**The masked and veiled killer** (line D; the owner, 20.11.2026, and the audit of 1.2.118).
- While a killer hides behind a "?", every day's board, a Call's confirmation, its refusals and its card name them "?".
  Masks now end just before the clock moves, so no board draws the masked killer.
- Private cards that hid a masked killer keep the "?" when they are given again after the mask ends, unless the killer
  revealed themselves (secret.mjs).
- While a killer waits behind the opening's veil, the other players' room pickers (hand over, Palm, Tail, a Call, a
  Monocub's ability) do not list them (mask-gm.mjs `veiledFromHere`; R7883).
- The hour a body was officially announced in ends on the day's board twice in a row, on every browser, once (the
  owner's option B; transitions.mjs `bodyBoardsOf`, sequence.mjs `bodyBoardPatch`; R7880, R7881).

**The Facilities window** (line T; the owner, 1.2.119: "Opisy kafli akcji gma w facilities dalej nie zawieraja ...").
- Every row now ends on what the room action gives: each effect with its amount, how long it lasts and who it falls on,
  or "No effect". A message the GM wrote is named but not shown until it is used (action-facilities.mjs `effectWords`;
  R7843).

**Sound > Effects** (line P; the owner, 20.11.2026: "niech kazdy wiersz wyglada jak ten pierwszy").
- Each event's files are listed one by one, each in its own box holding its path or link: editing a box replaces that
  file, emptying it removes it, and each has Play and Remove; the last box adds a file (sfx.mjs, sfx-play.mjs;
  R7833-R7835, tier 2 P119-S1). The tab updates at once for any GM's change.

**Movement** (line shim-118, with line L1's third reading on the owner's sandbox).
- A put-back no longer undoes a move it cannot show is the race: a move that started where the put-back aims, or whose
  record carries no origin, is kept; a put-back written while the token's newer move is on its way lands after it; one
  to the spot the token already stands on writes nothing (movement.mjs `putBackWrite`; five tier-2 tests). The mover's
  own charge does not wait.

## Before installing

- **No migration step** (scripts/migrate.mjs has no change). No setting is added or removed (`game.settings.register` on
  202 lines of scripts/ at both ends). The clock's record gains one field, `bodyBoard` (null until a body's hour is
  boarded; settings.mjs). The GMs' stores keep their definitions (gm-stores.mjs has no change); gm-store.mjs, the
  player copy, keeps rows written above a reset whose cut runs ahead (above).
- **Language**: lang/en.json goes from 6369 to 6402 keys: 34 added (the planner's `DRPG.CaseMap.goneRef`, `legendLabel`,
  `moveEnd.up`/`.down`; the Facilities rows' 18 `DRPG.Facility.gives*` keys; `DRPG.GmStore.cutAhead.one`/`.other`;
  `DRPG.Hud.trialNoSpeaker`, `DRPG.Zones.scrum.noSpeaker`; `DRPG.Items.discardNever`; six `DRPG.Sound.*` keys for the
  files; one tooltip, `DRPG.Tips.Sweep.Case.goneRefBoxTooltip`), 1 removed (`DRPG.Items.discardOnlyBroken`), 3 changed
  in wording (`DRPG.CaseMap.removeAsk`, `DRPG.Music.trialNote`, `DRPG.Sound.severalHint`). lang/pl.json goes from 7456
  to 7499: every English key and no other but the Polish plural forms (.few, .many; 544) and the 553 DRPG.Config.* keys
  (same count). Counted on the flattened files, b5a29e73 against 8c3a146e.
- No icon is added. No console name changed (tools/api-surface.json has no change in the range).
- **Daggerheart**: `verified` stays 2.12.9. **Foundry**: module.json's compatibility has no change (minimum 14.364,
  verified 14.365); the owner's sandbox runs 14.370, which module.json does not name.

## Known gaps

- **Not shipped**: E39, E40, E43, E53, E58 and E83 (tools/stages.json, planned 1.2.120). E26 stays 1.3.0.
- **No local gate has passed**: E119 declares sockets, rolls and scenes, so the gate is required, and no part of it has
  run on this release's tree; the record in the tree, audit/gate/local-gate.json, says every part not run for want of a
  server. Nothing in this release has run on a real Foundry or at a table.
- **Tier 2 at a table is not green**: line L1's last whole run of tier 2 on the owner's 14.370 sandbox, at d5907e1b,
  read 1326 passed, 214 failed, 26 skipped of 1566 (docs/dev/e58/LOCAL-REPORT.md); no whole run since, on any Foundry.
- **Not yet tried at a table**: every LIVE item this release writes or touches is open (## Checked, the last line).
- **The audit of 1.2.118 is not closed**: its findings in the files these lines touched were routed to them; the rest,
  among them the windows that do not yet refresh at once on a change, the masked killer's defence in a trial and the
  Room setup window after a death, are planned for 1.2.120 and later (audit/findings-1.2.118/ROUTING.md on the audit's
  branch).
- **Two veil predicates**: mask-gm.mjs `veiledFromHere` (the pickers) and visibility.mjs `voiceVeiledHere` (the voice
  tile) answer the same question in two places; read to agree on the harness, not yet one function.
- **Carried, not closed**: the 11 rows of audit/harness/known-leaks.json, as at 1.2.118 (only
  `foundry-veiled-token-actor`'s text changed); a race in the harness's fuzz (lib/fuzz.mjs, no change in the range).
  The rest of 1.2.118's list stands as its notes give it.
